contentText:
As expected, Apple finally showed off its 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pros at its recent " Pro and tell " event. The long-awaited laptops feature a Tandem OLED display with full touch capabilities, while also cutting some weight and bringing back the glowing Apple logo. While less exciting, there's also an updated 14-inch MacBook Pro that features Apple's M6 chip, along with improved wireless connectivity. It's a small, somewhat iterative update of the prior generation , with no substantial new features beyond performance gains.
